Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin ad- + via.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /av.viˈa.re/[1]
  • Rhymes: -are
  • Hyphenation: av‧vi‧à‧re
  • Audio:(file)

Verb

[edit]

avviàre (first-person singular present avvìo, first-person singular past historic avviài, past participle avviàto, auxiliary avére)

  1. (transitive) to send, to refer
  2. (transitive) to start, to launch
